# AccountingCoach

> > Comprehensive accounting education platform offering in-depth tutorials on GAAP, financial statements, and accounting principles by Harold Averkamp, CPA.

AccountingCoach provides free and PRO accounting education resources including detailed explanations, quizzes, flashcards, and business form templates. The site covers fundamental to advanced topics following U.S. GAAP standards, with a focus on financial statements, cash flows, inventory methods (FIFO/LIFO), and practical accounting applications.

## Key Topics

- GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles)
- Financial Statements
- Statement of Cash Flows
- Accounting Equation (Assets = Liabilities + Equity)
- FIFO and LIFO Inventory Methods
- Depreciation Methods
- Indirect Method for Cash Flows
- Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)
- Bank Reconciliation
- Effective Interest Method
- Balance Sheet Analysis
- U.S. SEC Reporting Requirements
- Nonprofit Accounting
- Financial Ratios
- Harold Averkamp (Author/CPA)

## Core Accounting Fundamentals

- [Accounting Equation: In-Depth Explanation with Examples](https://www.accountingcoach.com/accounting-equation/explanation/3): Assets = Liabilities + Equity fundamentals with transaction examples
- [Financial Statements: In-Depth Explanation with Examples](https://www.accountingcoach.com/financial-statements/explanation/4): Five required U.S. GAAP financial statements explained with examples
- [Cash Flow Statement: In-Depth Explanation with Examples](https://www.accountingcoach.com/cash-flow-statement/explanation/4): Statement of cash flows tutorial using indirect method with examples
- [Depreciation: In-Depth Explanation with Examples](https://www.accountingcoach.com/depreciation/explanation): Depreciation methods tutorial covering straight-line and accelerated
- [Bank Reconciliation: In-Depth Explanation with Examples](https://www.accountingcoach.com/bank-reconciliation/explanation): Bank reconciliation process guide with internal control examples

## Practice Quizzes and Learning Tools

- [Accounting Basics Quiz and Test](https://www.accountingcoach.com/accounting-basics/quiz): Beginner accounting fundamentals practice quiz by Harold Averkamp
- [Financial Statements Quiz and Test](https://www.accountingcoach.com/financial-statements/quiz): Practice quiz on financial statements and GAAP principles
- [Cash Flow Statement Quiz and Test](https://www.accountingcoach.com/cash-flow-statement/quiz): Practice quiz covering cash flow statement and indirect method topics
- [Inventory and Cost of Goods Sold Flashcards](https://www.accountingcoach.com/inventory-and-cost-of-goods-sold/flashcards): Flashcards for inventory accounting, COGS, FIFO, and LIFO concepts

## Business Forms and Templates

- [Free Cash Flow Calculator](https://www.accountingcoach.com/business-forms/free-cash-flow): Free cash flow calculation template for financial analysis
- [Sales Needed for Desired Net Income Calculator](https://www.accountingcoach.com/business-forms/sales-needed-for-desired-net-income): Calculator for sales needed to achieve target net income levels
- [Equity Ratio Calculator](https://www.accountingcoach.com/business-forms/equity-ratio): Equity ratio calculator template for balance sheet analysis
- [Amortization of Bond Discount: Effective Interest Method](https://www.accountingcoach.com/business-forms/amortization-of-bond-discount-effective-interest-method): Bond discount amortization template using effective interest method
- [Nonprofit's Statement of Functional Expenses](https://www.accountingcoach.com/business-forms/nonprofit-statement-of-functional-expenses): Nonprofit functional expenses statement template by Harold Averkamp
